replaces.idea: A standing vertical rack of physical toggle levers and tiny indicator bulbs wired to a bus bar at the base, representing memory-mapped I/O registers.
An upright, bracket-mounted solid-state drive cartridge with a ribbed heatsink cap, a bottom edge-connector tongue, and a tiny activity LED.

new.name: MMIO Register Rack
new.depicts: A standing vertical metal rack holding four rows of tiny toggle switches and indicator bulbs, bolted onto a flat baseplate with a bus-bar rail along the bottom.
new.focal: The row of glowing indicator bulbs beside the toggle switches

new.name: NVMe Cartridge
new.depicts: An upright solid-state drive cartridge mounted in a small vertical bracket, topped with a ribbed heatsink cap and showing a notched edge-connector tongue at the base.
new.focal: The ribbed heatsink cap with a single bright activity LED

new.name: Descriptor Carousel
new.depicts: A floor-mounted circular turntable machine on four stubby feet, carrying eight slotted packet trays around its rim past a fixed read/write gate arm.
new.focal: The fixed read/write gate arm poised over the rotating ring of trays

new.name: Watchdog Bell
new.depicts: A spring-wound mechanical desk timer on a weighted baseplate with a sweeping dial hand and a small hammer poised beside a dome bell.
new.focal: The poised hammer and dome bell atop the timer dial

rework.redesign: Raise the perforated transfer track onto two sturdy pedestal legs with a taller arched bridge housing so the sprite is at least 10 px tall and grounded on the floor.
Mount the storage module and controller chip side-by-side on a shared circuit-board baseplate connected by a physical ribbon-cable bridge.
Enlarge the scuttling bug's body to at least 6x6 px with a 1 px darkest-ink outline, add 1x1 px dark eyes, and trim the empty canvas padding.
